analyses.content: 录音中明确提到第一个职位是前台（receptionist）。
你可能听到后面提到了administration，但那是偏好条件，真正的职位名称是receptionist。
What are they? The first one is for a post as a receptionist.
录音中说明工作主要职责是提供高质量的客户服务（quality customer service）。
你容易只听到service而漏掉前面的核心修饰词customer或quality customer，填空时要注意抓住完整的词组。
Yes, of course. The job will be to mainly provide quality customer service, both over the phone and in person.
当问到工作时间时，录音明确回答你需要在一周内工作几个清晨（early mornings）。
你可能会听到后面的four days a week，但题目问的是具体的“时段”而非天数，注意抓住修饰mornings的early。
Do you have any information about the hours involved? It says here that you will be expected to work several early mornings, four days a week.
录音提到在胜任岗位前，你需要经历几周无薪的培训（unpaid training），对应题目中的without pay。
你可能听到unpaid后不知道填什么，这里的unpaid是对without pay的同义替换，其后的核心名词training才是真正的答案。
Any other requirements? Yeah. You'll have to go through a couple of weeks of unpaid training before qualifying for the post.
录音中男士介绍下一个职位时明确提到，这里有一个司机（driver）的招聘广告。
这道题非常直接，如果你错过了，可能是因为没有跟上话题从上一个职位向新职位的转换节奏。
Are there any other roles beginning later in the day? Yes. There's an advertisement here for a driver.
录音在介绍工作时间时，原词重现了working hours are flexible（灵活的）。
你可能会被后面一大串关于排班（personal schedule）的解释干扰，要记住紧跟提示词working hours锁定紧随其后的形容词。
Is there any more information? Yep. It says here that working hours are flexible, and the employers are happy to work within your personal schedule since they employ multiple drivers.
录音提到具体的职责包括去取购买的杂货（collecting the grocery shopping），这里的collecting完美对应题目的collect。
你容易只听到shopping而漏掉限定词grocery，导致答案不完整甚至改变了具体的语义。
As well as driving the employers to and from work, they will ask you to perform various duties on their behalf, such as collecting the grocery shopping and picking their children up from school.
女士询问是否需要在周末工作，男士否定并说明只需要在工作日上班，言下之意休息日就是周末（weekends）。
你可能会听到weekdays就急着写上去，但题目问的是“休息日（Day off）”而不是“工作日”，一定要听完后面的not weekends再做判断。
Do they need me to work a day on the weekend as well? No. It says here that they only require you to work on weekdays, not weekends.
录音引入第三个职位时，明确说是市中心一家电影院（cinema）的收银员。
题目要求填的是cashier工作的具体地点，如果你填了town就过于宽泛了，真正的直接工作场所是cinema。
Okay. So it's a post for a cashier in a cinema in the center of town.
录音中提到你需要接听电话并处理预订（take bookings），这里的take和题目的make是同义替换。
你可能会因为前面的tickets或refreshments分心，但注意题目是并列的第三个职责，紧跟连词also往后听就能抓到bookings。

Mm, can you tell me what the job involves? Yes, sure. It says that you'll be required to sell and dispense tickets and provide refreshments. Also, they ask that you be quick on the computers since you'll also need to take bookings over the phone, but you'll receive basic training for that.
